description: Připojení stavebního objektu k vodovodu - platný od 31.01.2025 is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Digital and Information agency. This is one of the data about the building. Coverage: Digital and Information agency. The portal shows the English title as "Connection of the building to the water supply - valid from 31.01.2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Digital and Information agency. Its keywords include connection to the water supply, připojení na vodovod, codelist, water supply, číselník, vodovod. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON_LD, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/17651921/911a0faf12d4a02726dad49b3423cab8/distribuce/f593ed0c8e2000c516e9939e4ae9b22a/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
